title: coleus aliciae
intro: Coleus aliciae, commonly known as Coleus aromaticus or Coleus scutellarioides, is a plant species in the mint family Lamiaceae. It is a tropical perennial plant native to India and Southeast Asia, known for its vibrant, colorful leaves and fragrant flowers. The health benefits of Coleus aliciae include its ability to reduce inflammation, lower blood pressure, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, which can help prevent infections and promote wound healing. The plant's bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, contribute to its therapeutic actions, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic effects.
